description: This is a test class for the AbstractRequestResponseClient, testing its behavior in sending and handling request-response messages within a messaging framework using Proton (AMQP) in the Eclipse Hono project.

classes.name: AbstractRequestResponseClientTest
classes.description: JUnit test class verifying behavior of AbstractRequestResponseClient, including message sending, response handling, caching, and error scenarios.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes mocks and creates an instance of the client for testing.

methods.name: testCreateAndSendRequestFailsWithServerErrorExceptionIfSendQueueFull
methods.description: Tests that the client fails with ServerErrorException when the sender's send queue is full.

methods.name: testCreateAndSendRequestSendsProperRequestMessage
methods.description: Validates that the client creates and sends a request message with correct headers and payload, and sets a timeout.

methods.name: testCreateAndSendRequestFailsOnRejectedMessage
methods.description: Ensures the client properly fails the handler when the peer rejects the request message.

methods.name: testHandleResponseInvokesHandlerForMatchingCorrelationId
methods.description: Checks that the client passes the response message to the correct handler based on correlation ID.

methods.name: testCancelRequestFailsResponseHandler
methods.description: Verifies that a request times out correctly and the handler is failed with a 503 error.

methods.name: testCreateAndSendRequestFailsIfSenderIsNotOpen
methods.description: Tests that sending a request fails immediately if the sender link is not open.

methods.name: testCreateAndSendRequestFailsIfReceiverIsNotOpen
methods.description: Tests that sending a request fails immediately if the receiver link is not open.

methods.name: testCreateAndSendRequestAddsResponseToCache
methods.description: Checks that response is cached with default timeout if no cache directives are present.

methods.name: testCreateAndSendRequestAddsResponseToCacheWithMaxAge
methods.description: Validates that response is cached with max-age directive if present.

methods.name: testCreateAndSendRequestDoesNotAddResponseToCache
methods.description: Ensures responses with no-cache directive are not cached.

methods.name: testCreateAndSendRequestDoesNotAddNonCacheableResponseToCache
methods.description: Checks that responses with non-cacheable status codes are not cached.

methods.name: testSendOneWayRequestSucceedsOnAcceptedMessage
methods.description: Verifies that sending a one-way request succeeds if the peer accepts.

methods.name: testGetCreditsReturnsCreditsOfSenderLink
methods.description: Checks that client correctly reports the current credit on the sender link.
